sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Clear Mobitel Ltd
sources.f: Published 28 May 2026 and statement updated 22 July 2026; Ofcom records the application and final direction process for Clear Mobitel Ltd.
sources.g: Code powers concern infrastructure rights and do not prove built or orderable service at a premises.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply code powers to London Fibre Group Limited
sources.f: Published 11 March 2026 and statement published 15 May 2026; Ofcom considered Code powers for London Fibre Group Limited.
sources.g: A final direction enables infrastructure activity but does not confirm network completion at an address.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Baltic Broadband Limited
sources.f: Statement published 30 January 2026; Ofcom records the Electronic Communications Code process for Baltic Broadband Limited.
sources.g: Regulatory status is not exact-address service evidence.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Jet Infrastructure Limited
sources.f: Statement published 27 January 2026; the page records Ofcom's Code-powers decision process for Jet Infrastructure Limited.
sources.g: Infrastructure powers do not establish retail broadband orderability.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Boom Telecom Networks Limited
sources.f: Ofcom records the proposal and statement process for Boom Telecom Networks Limited during 2026.
sources.g: Code designation cannot be promoted to parcel connectivity truth.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Village Networks Limited
sources.f: Published in 2026; Ofcom records its review of Village Networks Limited's Code-powers application.
sources.g: The regulatory decision does not prove active network service for a premises.

sources.t: Statement: Proposal to apply Code powers to Teleauora Ltd
sources.f: Statement published 27 January 2026; Ofcom records the Code-powers process for Teleauora Ltd.
sources.g: Code powers are not a current coverage or service-activation check.

sources.t: Proposal to apply Code powers to G.Network Holdco Limited
sources.f: Published 10 June 2026; Ofcom proposed applying the Electronic Communications Code to G.Network Holdco Limited.
sources.g: A pending regulatory proposal does not establish infrastructure completion or orderability.

sources.t: Enforcement programme launched into industry's Funds for Liabilities compliance
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened a programme covering Code Operators' annual funds-for-liabilities duties.
sources.g: Compliance monitoring concerns financial safeguards and does not prove parcel service.

sources.t: Electronic Communications Code: rights and obligations
sources.f: Official guidance explains Code rights, Ofcom directions, registration and enforcement responsibilities.
sources.g: General legal guidance is not evidence that a particular network reaches an address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Nottinghamshire and West Lincolnshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records that the CityFibre contract ended and alternative arrangements are being discussed.
sources.g: Contract termination and replacement planning do not establish current service at a premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - East and West Sussex
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned CityFibre contract covering around 13,000 premises.
sources.g: Redesigned scope is programme evidence, not a live order check.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cambridgeshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a revised Cambridgeshire contract covering around 35,000 premises.
sources.g: Contract maps and scope remain subject to detailed planning and do not prove parcel service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cheshire
sources.f: Updated 27 February 2026; BDUK records termination of the Freedom Fibre contract and inclusion in Openreach call-off eight.
sources.g: Transferred procurement scope is not exact current service evidence.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Bedfordshire, Northamptonshire and Milton Keynes
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned contract covering around 6,000 premises.
sources.g: Revised contract totals do not confirm active retail availability for an address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - West Herefordshire and Forest of Dean
sources.f: Official guidance records the Project Gigabit contract and its April 2026 update.
sources.g: Awarded or amended build scope does not prove completion at a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire and East Berkshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned contract covering around 6,000 premises.
sources.g: Programme scope and investment figures require fresh UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Hampshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; BDUK records a redesigned Hampshire contract covering around 29,000 premises.
sources.g: Planned contract coverage is not present-day exact-address orderability.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract - Northern Ireland
sources.f: Published 16 December 2025; the Northern Ireland Executive awarded Fibrus a contract covering over 9,000 premises.
sources.g: Contract award and programme totals do not prove a specific premises has an active service.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Lincolnshire and East Riding of Yorkshire
sources.f: Published 25 July 2024; BDUK records the Quickline contract for around 72,000 hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: Target premises can change during detailed planning and require current provider validation.
